title.narrative: Western Balkans Enterprise Development and Innovation Facility Guarantee Facility – Serbia Window (“WB EDIF GF Serbia”)

description.narrative: The activity has been conceived within the scope of the WBEDIF GF II but is dedicated solely to Serbia. Guarantees will be provided to eligible Financial Intermediaries to encourage them to build up new portfolios of SME transactions. The guarantee instrument envisaged for this Serbia Window has the same features of the guarantee product already offered in the region but with focus on innovative companies and start-ups.
